controversies.title: Ratable Base Balance & Budgetary Oversight (Passaic City)
controversies.entityInvolved: Passaic City Municipal Administration & Tax Assessor
controversies.summary: High-density urban community; State Aid covers 82.5% of school operations. Effective tax rate is 2.113%, but lower median incomes result in a 16.57% household tax burden.
controversies.investigationDetails: Annual review of municipal tax appeals and school district funding allocations under Passaic County Board of Taxation guidelines.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Affects composite property tax millage and municipal equalized ratables.
